findings.title: Keep 山 seal-redraw descriptions tied to the image and evidence
findings.details: Review rounds 0–2 flagged inaccurate geometry and an unsupported claim that the seal-style redraw is a later stylized form of the mountain pictograph. Round 3 then passed after revisions. The current caption and alt describe three strokes rising from a curved base, while the caption limits the image to a modern redraw and says the listed forms do not establish continuity. These were rejected draft claims, not errors in the approved article.
findings.verification: On future edits to this glyph caption or alt text, compare the wording with the exact attached redraw and cited evidence; retain its modern-redraw qualification and do not imply a graphic transition without supporting evidence.

findings.title: Retain the provenance limit on 山 scan checks
findings.details: The supplied research records say PDF p. 823 / printed p. 810 and continuation p. 824 were checked against scans by an earlier researcher, but later follow-up researchers did not personally inspect those scan pixels. No OCR correction is proposed, and the approved article does not rely on a reported correction. Preserve this distinction between dossier-reported inspection and the follow-up researchers’ direct inspection.
findings.verification: If a future OCR correction or claim of direct scan verification is proposed for these pages, inspect the exact source scan and occurrence with adjacent anchors, then record source-bound evidence; otherwise keep the prior scan check attributed to the earlier dossier research.
